correctness.rationale: For death–Birth update on K_(2,3), the lumped (i,j) count chain has 10 transient states and four rates: (2-i)rj/(3-j+rj), i(3-j)/(3-j+rj), (3-j)ri/(2-i+ri), j(2-i)/(2-i+ri). Supplied rational polynomial certificate N_(i,j)/(60(r+1)Q(r)) has Q positive coefficients; original verifier algebra explicitly checks all ten coefficientwise backward equations, not a finite sample. Independently used symbolic algebra to verify F_(1,1)-F_(2,0)=H/(60(r+1)Q) exactly; all pairwise domination polynomials have positive coefficients. H has one descending-coefficient sign change and H(1)<0<H(3), so exactly one positive root 2.05144026631733... . Neutral r=1 probabilities independently checked as 1/2,5/12,1/3. Full-state rational finite checks are supporting, not a substitute for polynomial identities.
